title: Design System: King of the Court

statsNumber.purpose: The large number in a stat tile — Win Rate, King count, XP, record.

body.purpose: Default running text across dense operate surfaces (11-13px, smaller than typical web body text).

label.purpose: Tiny uppercase tracked captions under stat numbers and section eyebrows.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus color and border transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid-fill button in the system — reserved for the single primary action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d5ff40; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d5ff40; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Button (Confirm)
components.description: Tinted secondary action button — 15% background tint, 25% border tint, solid text, in a semantic color (shown here in win-green).
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.15); color: #4ade80; border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.25); font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.25); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4ade80; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Read-only pill status indicator, shown here in the King/accent variant.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: rgba(213, 255, 64, 0.15); color: #d5ff40; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default bordered container — one tonal step above the page background, hairline border that brightens on hover when interactive.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141414; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #9c9c94; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #ffffff; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; color: #c0c2b8; margin: 0; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: The system's signature component: a large font-black stat number over a tiny uppercase tracked label. Used for every at-a-glance metric.
components.css: .ds-stat-tile { background: #141414; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px; text-align: center; } .ds-stat-number { font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; color: #4ade80; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9c9c94; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text field — recessed to the deepest black tone, lime border on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #000000; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9c9c94; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #d5ff40; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Desktop left-rail navigation item — lime left-border and tinted background when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #9c9c94; border-left: 2px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #c0c2b8; background: #1c1c1c; } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #d5ff40; border-left-color: #d5ff40; background: rgba(213, 255, 64, 0.1); }

narrative.overview: Blacktop Neon is the outdoor court after dark: asphalt gone black, one lime floodlight cutting through it. The system is built for a phone in someone's hand at the edge of a real court, not a desktop marketing site — dense, legible, fast to scan, confident rather than decorative. The lime accent is the single loud voice in an otherwise near-silent black-and-gray room; everything else recedes so that voice reads as a signal rather than noise. The system rejects a soft glassy 'gamer neon' look (glows, gradients, drop shadows) and a cold enterprise-dashboard look (navy, muted blues, timid accents). Depth comes from tonal steps of near-black, never from shadows or glow; confidence comes from hard-edged cards and unambiguous status color, never from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Pure near-black surfaces with tonal (not shadow-based) depth
One accent color, spent deliberately: lime for the primary action and King status
Poppins throughout — geometric, confident, from a 9px label to a 48px number
Dense, mobile-first Operate layout: stat tiles, bordered cards, tight uppercase labels
Soft corners (10-16px), never sharp, never fully rounded except pills/avatars

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Lime never appears twice for two different meanings on one screen — if a court is King, lime means King there; if a button is a CTA, lime means "go" there.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Body copy on operate surfaces runs 11-13px, not 16px — this app is read in short glances on a phone at a court.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If something needs to look elevated, give it the next tone step and a hairline border — never a shadow, never a glow.

dos: Do spend lime deliberately — one primary action or one King status per view, never ambient decoration.
Do use the stat-tile pattern (big number + tiny uppercase label) for any new at-a-glance metric.
Do convey elevation with a tonal step + hairline border, never a shadow.
Do default to 11-13px body text on operate surfaces.
Do use ink-black (not white) as the text color on a lime background.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a theme toggle — dark-only is a committed product decision.
Don't hardcode hex colors in new components — always use the CSS variable tokens.
Don't add box-shadow, glow, or blur effects anywhere — depth is tonal only.
Don't reuse lime for a second, unrelated meaning on the same screen.
